definitions: The United Nations system refers to the entire organizational structure of the United Nations, including its principal organs, specialized agencies, funds, and programs.
It encompasses the various entities that work together under the UN's mandate to address global issues such as peace and security, human rights, humanitarian aid, and sustainable development.
examples: The UN system plays a crucial role in international diplomacy.
Reforms are often proposed for the UN system.
Many organizations are part of the broader UN system.
